name: Kinshin Souai ~Haha ni Koi Shita Boku~
original_name: 禁親相愛～母に恋した僕～
source:
You play as Masaru, a 19 year old boy who just entered university. Even since you can remember, it has always been just you and your mother, a single mother. You don't have many guy friends, not that you aren't likable, it's just that your mother is a raging MILF and you'd prefer to not invite them over to your home. Now that you've grown-up into a man you've started to have... other feeling for your mother you know that aren't right. But how far will love take you, and how much can your body resist? 

[From [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/PCG1173]J-List[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演刚上大学的19岁少年月咏润。
从记事起，他便一直与身为单亲母亲的母亲相依为命。
他没什么男性朋友，并非因为不讨人喜欢，而是因为母亲实在风韵十足，他不愿把他们带回家。

如今，他已长成男人，也开始对母亲萌生了……不该有的情愫。
爱能将人带到多远，肉体又能抵抗到何种程度？
